chapter: Decca, Cow Cow Blues and royalties
title: Decca sessions: 'Fetch It To Me', Lester Young and his songs
summary: He lists his own Decca dates, including 'Just Jivin' Around' with Lester Young and songs he wrote and sang.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: My own group, yeah. But all this was for Decca. Then I did that "Just Jivin' Around" with Lester Young. Well now, I understand that those solos and some of those things that were played are supposed to be pretty good, you know, accountability of a guy that can't play. So then I wrote a song called, "The Letter," and I sang a song called, "Thinking." I had no idea, Dan, that the damn song was anything, you know. And people were writing me letters but I never have...I wanted to say but I never could bring...that's one of the things I never could bring myself around to doing is singing. Now I made, you know, I made "C. C. Rider" and I do a lot of tricks with records today because you make records for a guy and they ain't going to give you your royalties; you write a lot of original tunes and the guy figure you're going to die, so then he, you know, will just wait until the sun shine Nellie before anything happens, so finally I just decided that I would go ahead on the way I do now. If a guy want me to do a record date, you know, I do the same thing
